question: Does the slow-tumbler inversion pipeline (|ω| clamp + anchor-cap + surrogate LM polish) recover the true attitude+spin state of slow tumblers as Band-A multi-solution sets?
hypothesis: The slow-tumbler pipeline recovers truth in Band A as a multi-solution set on slow seeds.
narrative_md: Report on the slow-tumbler pipeline (|ω| clamp + anchor-cap dt_ab<π/ω_hi + surrogate LM polish) on seeds 116 and 10. Both recover truth in Band A as multi-solution sets: 116 → 7 solutions (4 Band A, truth q0 0.19°/ω-dir 0.03°); 10 → 6 solutions (3 Band A, truth q0 2.41°/ω-dir 1.18°). Inconclusive overall: surrogate-only (no hi-fi confirmation), seed 10's candidates came from an over-coarsened set (lower bound), and N=2 with seeds 42/31 needing the decimation/sampling fixes first. Surrogate-only; truth used as label/diagnostic.
